actions.label: Prepare the Notice of Rent Review
actions.when: a rent review is legally available

actions.label: Serve the notice correctly
actions.current_procedure: From 14 September 2026, a copy of a notice of rent review must be served to the RTB within 7 days of serving it on the tenant.

actions.label: Gather supporting evidence
actions.when: special exception or exemption is claimed
documents: related certificate of compliance on completion where applicable

guardrail: The action layer must only expose an action when the legal composition identifies that route as relevant. An official link is not a determination that the user is entitled or required to take that action.
